name: Arabian Gulf
description:
Arabian Gulf is a thrilling survival action game where every second is a test of your skill and courage. Equip your weapons and brace yourself for an unforgettable battle for survival against relentless enemies in a vast, unforgiving desert.

Your journey is fraught with danger, but the goal is clear: fight your way through treacherous landscapes, conquer the challenges, and reach the ancient castle to claim the legendary treasures hidden within.

  • Epic survival action in a dynamic desert environment

  • Face relentless enemies in intense combat

  • Conquer the castle and claim your rightful treasures

Are you ready to carve your legend in the sands of the Arabian Gulf?

requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
OS: Windows 10/11
Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
Storage: 4 GB available space
requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
OS: Windows 10/11
Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
Storage: 4 GB available space
